scope.pasc_note: PASC is included as an evidence-reviewed six-component aggregate. Its calculations match R; named sensitivity ranges retain scientific uncertainty that is not represented as a confidence interval.
scope.population_model: Stable adult population with replacement into H

configuration.aging_of_mortality_and_life_expectancy_a: FALSE; adult-population-weighted values are held constant
configuration.acute_ifr_method: Age-specific IFR multiplied by age-specific remaining life expectancy and ACS adult population share, then summed
configuration.long_covid_onset_formula: annual infection proportion * Long COVID risk per infection
configuration.reporting_unit: cumulative five-year DALYs per person and per 1,000 adults

pasc_derived_summaries.derivation: Sum of disability-weighted condition person-time divided by total condition person-time
pasc_derived_summaries.interpretation: Descriptive five-year baseline summary; not an operational model input

pasc_derived_summaries.parameter: Effective PASC mortality ratio relative to age-matched background mortality
pasc_derived_summaries.derivation: One plus condition-attributable deaths divided by expected background deaths during the same age-specific condition person-time
pasc_derived_summaries.interpretation: Descriptive five-year baseline effective ratio; not an operational model input or a pooled study hazard ratio
